releaseNotes: 6D6X6 2.5.74.0: fixes the remaining Windows 11 FPS collapse across the full H.264 path. WebRTC now negotiates one exact packetization-mode=1 Constrained Baseline format, Media Foundation emits the matching 42C032 SPS, and Host validates the first key frame against the SDP before streaming. This prevents Chromium from accepting RTP bytes but discarding dependent frames because the advertised and actual H.264 profiles differed. DXGI capture, audio, input and existing network routes are unchanged.
